svg.title: You never needed the stream. You needed 100 slots.
svg.desc: A whiteboard sketch showing a stream of ten million values flowing off the page with the naive approach of collecting and sorting everything crossed out in red at 22.37 seconds and 411.6 megabytes; a six-node min-heap with the root ringed and labelled the bouncer; the two-way decision where a value greater than the root replaces it and sifts down in about seven swaps while a smaller value is discarded after one comparison; a sift-down drawn with numbered swaps; and a bar chart where the bounded heap uses 14.8 megabytes against 411.6, at 2.00 seconds against 22.37.
svg.text: You never needed the stream. You needed 100 slots.
10,000,000 values go past. You want the top 100.
